comparison.objective: Install a rack rail; record safely routes a curved board using a starting pin and bearing.
comparison.physical_skill: Staged prong insertion and fastening versus pivoting and feeding stock along a rotating-tool path while avoiding kickback geometry.
comparison.success_condition: Persistent four-point rail retention and correct screws versus routed-length thresholds, feed direction, cutter clearance, and safe release.
comparison.reason: Both require controlled alignment, but the tested mechanical abilities and failure modes are materially different.
